images.title: A litre line in fourths
images.purpose: Give a measuring cue for ordering six milk amounts: a line of litres marked in fourths, split at 1 litre into below and above.
images.composition: One long number line across the middle of the frame with generous space above and below, and one short question line centred above it.
images.exact_structure: One horizontal number line from 0 to 3 litres, drawn in teal #0072B2, with 13 evenly spaced ticks marking 12 equal intervals, 4 intervals in each litre. The ticks at 0, 1, 2 and 3 are taller; the tick at 1 litre is tall and reddish purple #CC79A7. Small ticks are grey #6B7280 and unlabelled. No points marked on the line. One question line centred above. Exactly 1 line, 13 ticks, 4 labelled ticks.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
unevenly spaced ticks, or any amount, fraction or dot marked on the line
images.takeaway: Turn each word into an amount, then see if it is below or above 1 litre.
images.description: A number line from 0 to 3 litres with 12 equal fourth intervals, the 1 litre tick highlighted, under the question Below 1 litre or above?
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say each milk word as a number of litres and point to where it would sit on the line.

image_decisions.why: A litre line in fourths split at 1 litre gives the ordering cue without placing any of the answers.
